note: Scripture is OLCB (lug_bib, the ebible mirror's USX). 'mined' means the OLCB wording sits verbatim in the body; the body mirrors the English source's straight quote marks and apostrophes, so OLCB's curly ’ “ ” are written ' and " (typography only, no letter changed).
Philippians 2:1-11 is read verbatim from OLCB; the reader's spoken aside 'going to the lowest for us' after verse 8 is kept as his own words outside the verse wording.

Joshua 14:6-14: verses 6-9 and 11 are verbatim; v10 follows the English's 'forty and five years' and 'eighty-five' where OLCB prints forty and eighty, v12 keeps Evans's added 'the giants were there', v13-14 follow his shorter wording (Kebbulooni for Caleb, 'the Lord his God'), so those are self_rendered.

Numbers 14:23-24 is Evans's own paraphrase of the text, repeated three times; it reuses OLCB's phrases («omwoyo ogw'enjawulo», «ndimuleeta mu nsi, n'ezzadde lye lirigirya») but is not verbatim. Hebrews 4 is announced as a paraphrase in the sermon itself.
Evans's 'Ishbi-Ben-Arb' (2 Samuel 21:16, OLCB Isubibenobu) is kept as he said it; it is a retelling, not a quotation, so no row.
